attchmntText: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Transcript of Earnings Call held on November 03, 2026.
voiceSummary: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 03, 2026. The company reported revenue of INR645 crores, a 12.5% year-on-year increase, with operating margins at 18.5%. Management discussed a proposed combination with ITC Infotech announced on August 31, which is pending shareholder approval. The combined entity aims for US$1 billion in annual revenue by FY28. The firm serves 311 active customers, including 95 billion-dollar corporations, with repeat business at 95.1%. Strategic initiatives include Project Reimagine and the AI platform Rel(AI)Build, adopted by 15 customers. The Americas contributed 56% of revenue, while BFSI remained the largest vertical at 28%.

attchmntText: General Insurance Corporation of India has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr. Suresh Sindhi as Appointed Actuary (Life) and Key Managerial Person of the Corporation w.e.f. November 09, 2026.
voiceSummary: General Insurance Corporation of India disclosed the renewal of Shri Suresh Sindhi as Appointed Actuary and Key Managerial Person for one year effective 9th November 2026. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The company filed this notice with BSE and NSE under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. Shri Sindhi holds a postgraduate degree in Statistics and has over two decades of actuarial experience. He is a fellow member of the Institute of Actuaries of India and the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries UK. He has been associated with GIC Re since November 2023.

attchmntText: Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management - Appointment of Secretarial Auditor
voiceSummary: Veegaland Developers Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 09, 2026. The Board approved the appointment of Dr. George Sleeba, DIN 01217286, as an Additional Director and Whole-time Director with the designation Executive Director. This appointment is for a term of three consecutive years from November 10, 2026, to November 09, 2029, subject to shareholder approval through a postal ballot process. Dr. Sleeba currently holds 65,000 shares, representing 0.13% of the company. Concurrently, Mr. Kurian Thomas, DIN 10279590, resigned from his position as Whole-time Director and Key Managerial Personnel, effective from the closure of business hours on November 09, 2026. Mr. Thomas cited other interests as the reason for his resignation and confirmed no other material reasons exist. The Board also approved the appointment of M/s. Dedhia Shah & Partners LLP, Firm registration number L2025MH019000, as Secretarial Auditors for five consecutive years from Financial Year 2026-27 to 2030-31, subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. The notice for these appointments will be sent to shareholders. The trading window for the company's securities, closed since November 08, 2026, will reopen on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Whirlpool of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 09, 2026, titled "KEY HIGHLIGHTS OF Q2 2026-27".
voiceSummary: Whirlpool of India Limited filed a press release regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs 1873 Cr, representing a 14% year-on-year increase. Consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs 40 Cr with a margin of 2.1%, which was lower by 140 basis points compared to the previous year. Consolidated profit before tax was Rs 34 Cr, a margin of 1.8%, lower by 110 basis points versus the previous year. The company launched the Luxuriem refrigerator range. Profitability faced headwinds from commodity inflation, crude oil price increases, and currency depreciation. An additional price increase of approximately 5% was implemented effective November 1, 2026. Subsidiary Elica India reported a 12% revenue increase and a 22% profit before tax increase for the quarter.

attchmntText: Balaji Amines Limited has informed the Exchange about Submission of Earning Call Transcript under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Balaji Amines Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 4th November 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 stood at INR472 crores, up from INR348 crores in Q2 FY26. Consolidated EBITDA was INR106 crores, compared to INR67 crores in the prior year. Profit after tax was INR67 crores, against INR37 crores in Q2 FY26. Diluted EPS was INR20.76 per equity share. Consolidated sales volumes were 24,491 metric tons. The company commenced commercial production at its expanded Acetonitrile facility with capacity of 1,440 tons per month. The DME plant was commissioned. Balaji Specialty Chemicals expansion projects are progressing, with Unit-1 expected to commission towards the end of FY27 and Unit-2 targeted for Q4 FY27. Consolidated net worth as of 30th September 2026 was INR2,083.02 crores. Consolidated debt stood at INR161.15 crores. The company maintains a zero debt position on a standalone basis.

voiceSummary: Arvind Fashions Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with BSE and NSE on November 9, 2026. The call was held on November 3, 2026. The company reported record quarterly revenue and EBITDA for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue grew 10% to INR 1,559 crores. Adjusted for event shifts, growth was nearly 15%. EBITDA expanded by 67 basis points to INR 216 crores. Profit after tax rose 29% to INR 48 crores. Direct-to-consumer channels now account for 53% of sales. Retail like-for-like growth was 7.3%. Online B2C sales grew 28%. The company is setting up a new shirt manufacturing factory in Madhya Pradesh. Management guided for mid-double-digit growth in the balance of the year.

attchmntText: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited has informed the Exchange about Adjudication Order passed u/s 73 of CGST Act/ TGST Act, 2017
voiceSummary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited received an Adjudication Order dated 07.11.2026 from the Assistant Commissioner of the Telangana Commercial Tax Department on 09.11.2026. The order drops the entire GST demand of Rs. 207.26 Crore raised for the financial year 2022-23, along with consequential interest and penalty. This follows a previous favorable order for FY 2021-22, which dropped a demand of Rs. 183.77 Crore. The company initially faced tentative GST demands totaling Rs. 586.43 Crore across three financial years. The matter for FY 2023-24, involving a demand of Rs. 194.62 Crore, remains under adjudication. The company states there are no financial implications or penalties imposed. No action is warranted as the authority has dropped the raised demand.

attchmntText: KSH International Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: KSH International Limited submitted the transcript of its earnings conference call for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026, held on November 05, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 1,320 crores, an 85% increase year-over-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 90 crores, with EBITDA per ton at approximately Rs. 1,01,000. Profit after tax reached a quarterly record of Rs. 48 crores. Export revenue grew 108% year-over-year, representing 32% of total revenue. Installed capacity reached 57,845 metric tons, with 96% of Phase-2 expansion complete. The board approved a Phase-3 expansion to add capacity, targeting a total installed capacity of approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029. The investment is estimated at up to Rs. 1,850 million. The company generated Rs. 43 crores in positive operating cash flow during H1 FY 2027.

attchmntText: Auri Grow India Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process

attchmntText: Neogen Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Fire Incident - Order for Revocation of earlier Directions issued by GPCB and granting of CC&A Amendment by GPCB.
voiceSummary: Neogen Chemicals Limited received a Revocation of Direction order from the Gujarat Pollution Control Board on November 7, 2026. This order revokes previous directives issued after the March 5, 2025 fire incident at the Dahej SEZ Multi-Purpose Plant 3 facility. The Board also granted a provisional consent order, designated CC&A amendment AWH-163560, valid until March 19, 2030. The earlier direction had imposed an Environment Damage Compensation cost of Rs. 34.60 lakhs and required a Bank Guarantee of Rs. 7.5 Lakhs. Production at the affected plant was suspended, but the company has installed a new replacement MPP-5 plant which is currently in trial production. The revocation is subject to compliance with the submitted undertaking dated September 1, 2026, and the conditions of the new consent order.

The appointment is on full-time employment terms. Mr. Mewada brings over 20 years of experience in Health, Safety, Security and Environment, along with approximately nine years in electrical maintenance. He previously served as Assistant Vice President of HSSE at Pipeline Infrastructure Limited. His prior roles include positions at Torrent Gas Limited, Mahanagar Gas Limited, APM Terminals, Mundra International Container Terminal, and British Gas Exploration and Production India Limited. He holds an Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety, a Degree in Electrical Engineering, and a Diploma in Electrical Engineering. He is a Certified Safety Professional and an Approved Safety Auditor. He completed a Management Development Programme at IIM Ahmedabad. There is no disclosed relationship between Mr. Mewada and the company directors.

voiceSummary: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited approved the execution of a Shareholders Agreement with TPG SG Arca Pte Ltd for TPG's proposed investment in step-down subsidiary Arka Fincap Limited. The agreement records rights and obligations among Kirloskar Oil Engines, wholly owned subsidiary Arka Financial Holdings Private Limited, Arka Fincap, and TPG. TPG will subscribe to equity and compulsorily convertible preference shares in two tranches. The first tranche involves an investment of INR 525,00,00,003 for 100 equity shares and 32,53,45,231 preference shares. The second tranche involves an investment of INR 275,00,00,588 for 12,93,34,496 preference shares, subject to business milestones and regulatory approvals. Post-investment, Kirloskar Oil Engines will hold 62.607% of Arka Fincap. The agreement grants TPG one nominee director and certain minority protection rights. There is no impact on the management or control of Kirloskar Oil Engines.

attchmntText: Tata Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "TML CV Holdings B.V., an Indirect Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Tata Motors Limited (formerly TML Commercial Vehicles Limited) ( the Company )   Voluntary Totalitarian Tender Offer for all the common shares of Iveco Group N.V.".
voiceSummary: Tata Motors Limited disclosed that its subsidiary TML CV Holdings B.V. reached a provisional shareholding of 96.29% in Iveco Group N.V. following the reopening of a voluntary totalitarian tender offer. During the reopening, which ended on November 7, 2026, 18,309,029 common shares were tendered. The offer price is EUR 14.40 per share. Payment for these shares is scheduled for November 13, 2026. Due to exceeding the 95% threshold, the offeror intends to commence a Dutch legal squeeze-out for remaining shares. Final results will be announced by November 12, 2026. Trading in Iveco Group N.V. shares will be suspended.

The brand is the face of our company, it shows our personality   what we stand for, what we are passionate about and what our customers can expect from us.The SKF Vertevo brand is inspired by the world of racing, where the company has contributed to automotive innovation for decades. The identity is designed to keep a connection to the long SKF heritage and expertise, while signalling its ambition to help accelerate the future of mobility.Please note that only the brand is being launched, while the company name continues to remain the same. Any further developments will be communicated to stakeholders as and when applicable.
